q: how much does it cost to make a steel axe on eco at current prices? is it profitable to craft?

body.reply:
Eco is currently in the off-season until 2026-10-09, so there is no active market and no current prices to reference.

A steel axe in Eco generally requires iron ore and coal, processed through a forge into iron ingots. The exact recipe and resource costs depend on the version and modlist (the server is moving to 0.14.1 with modlist 23 when the season reopens).

Since the game is offline, live market data is unavailable. When the season restarts on 2026-10-09, the crafting economy will be active again and prices will be set by player supply and demand.

> 🔨 ✅ `discord.list_channel-message` ×3
